subject: FORMATS: HW decode = H.264, HEVC(+Main10, HEIF), VP9(p0/p2), AV1, VP8, MPEG-1/2, MPEG-4, H.263; NOT VC-1/RV; HW encode = H.264/HEVC/HEIF/JPEG only
body: facts/FORMATS.md (matrix, evidence, per-format register cost, model rules, phone procedure). All decode sub-blocks lie in RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL; every format is direct MMIO (no GCE) on the PC; single-core formats (VP8, MPEG-1/2/4, H.263) = LOCK_CORE + 1 WAITISR, LAT+core (H.264/HEVC/VP9/AV1) = 2. PC: the phone's vpud completes 10/10-picture sessions for MPEG-2, MPEG-4, H.263, VP8, VP9 p0, VP9 p2, AV1, HEVC Main10 (fmt/run_fmt.sh, model fmt/n2vdec_fmt_fake.c) and the PRODUCT path (vcodecd --decoder + n2vcd_dprobe, one process) passes 7 streams (fmt/run_sim_fmt.sh -> N2TEST FMT-SIM PASS 7). VC-1/WMV: libvcodecdrv only dlopens a CPU decoder libvc1dec_sa.ca7.so that is NOT on this phone. MPEG-4/H.263/VP8 encoders in the vendor stack are CPU code (libmp4enc_sa, libvp8enc_sa) - not worth hosting. 10-bit (HEVC Main10, VP9 p2) outputs MT2T (MT2110T), which n2_mm21 does not detile yet. Phone payload staged: payload-vcodec-fmt (vc7-fmt), owned-vcodec-fmt.json, REHEARSAL_OK; commands FORMATS.md section 7. Nothing touched on the phone.
